narration.en: Bite into a guava or a sapota and you feel tiny hard grains. Those grains are dead, thick-walled cells called sclereids.
narration.kn: ಸೀಬೆ ಅಥವಾ ಸಪೋಟವನ್ನು ಕಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಸಣ್ಣ ಗಟ್ಟಿ ಕಣಗಳು ಸಿಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವು ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೈಡ್ ಎಂಬ ದಪ್ಪ ಗೋಡೆಯ ನಿರ್ಜೀವ ಕೋಶಗಳು.

body.en: Parenchyma forms the major part of plant organs. Its cells are generally isodiametric, with thin walls of cellulose, and may be closely packed or have small spaces between them. Parenchyma performs photosynthesis, storage and secretion.
body.kn: ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಸಸ್ಯಾಂಗಗಳ ಬಹುಭಾಗ. ತೆಳು ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಸಮವ್ಯಾಸದ ಕೋಶಗಳು; ದ್ಯುತಿಸಂಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ, ಸ್ರವಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Parenchyma forms the major part of plant organs. Its cells are generally isodiametric, with thin walls of cellulose, and may be closely packed or have small spaces between them. Parenchyma performs photosynthesis, storage and secretion.
narration.kn: ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಸಸ್ಯಾಂಗಗಳ ಬಹುಭಾಗ. ತೆಳು ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಸಮವ್ಯಾಸದ ಕೋಶಗಳು; ದ್ಯುತಿಸಂಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ, ಸ್ರವಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Collenchyma occurs below the epidermis in dicotyledonous plants, either as a uniform layer or in patches. Its cells are much thickened at the corners because of a deposit of cellulose, hemicellulose and pectin. It may contain chloroplasts and gives mechanical support to growing parts such as the young stem and the petiole of a leaf.
body.kn: ಕೊಲೆಂಕೈಮಾ ದ್ವಿದಳ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳ ಹೊರಚರ್ಮದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋಶಗಳ ಮೂಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್, ಹೆಮಿಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್, ಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್ ದಪ್ಪಗಳು. ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರ.

points.en: Support to young stems and petioles

narration.en: Collenchyma occurs below the epidermis in dicotyledonous plants, either as a uniform layer or in patches. Its cells are much thickened at the corners because of a deposit of cellulose, hemicellulose and pectin. It may contain chloroplasts and gives mechanical support to growing parts such as the young stem and the petiole of a leaf.
narration.kn: ಕೊಲೆಂಕೈಮಾ ದ್ವಿದಳ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳ ಹೊರಚರ್ಮದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋಶಗಳ ಮೂಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್, ಹೆಮಿಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್, ಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್ ದಪ್ಪಗಳು. ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರ.

body.en: Sclerenchyma has long or narrow cells with thick, lignified walls with few or many pits, and the cells are usually dead. Fibres are thick-walled, elongated and pointed. Sclereids are spherical, oval or cylindrical, highly thickened dead cells with very narrow cavities; they are found in the fruit walls of nuts, the pulp of guava, pear and sapota, the seed coats of legumes and the leaves of tea. Sclerenchyma gives mechanical support.
body.kn: ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಕೋಶಗಳು ದಪ್ಪ ಲಿಗ್ನಿನ್ ಗೋಡೆಯ ನಿರ್ಜೀವ ಕೋಶಗಳು: ನಾರುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೈಡ್‌ಗಳು. ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೈಡ್‌ಗಳು ಸೀಬೆ, ಪೇರಳೆ, ಸಪೋಟದ ತಿರುಳಿನಲ್ಲಿವೆ.

points.en: Sclereids: guava, pear, sapota pulp; nut shells; tea leaves

narration.en: Sclerenchyma has long or narrow cells with thick, lignified walls with few or many pits, and the cells are usually dead. Fibres are thick-walled, elongated and pointed. Sclereids are spherical, oval or cylindrical, highly thickened dead cells with very narrow cavities; they are found in the fruit walls of nuts, the pulp of guava, pear and sapota, the seed coats of legumes and the leaves of tea.

caption.en: A parenchyma cell is a typical living plant cell like this one: a thin cellulose wall, a large central vacuole and, in the leaf, many chloroplasts. Collenchyma is also living, but sclerenchyma cells are usually dead and thick-walled.

narration.en: A parenchyma cell is a typical living plant cell like this one: a thin cellulose wall, a large central vacuole and, in the leaf, many chloroplasts. Collenchyma is also living, but sclerenchyma cells are usually dead and thick-walled.

problem.en: A tissue in the petiole of a leaf has living cells with walls thickened only at the corners, and some cells contain chloroplasts. Identify it and state its function.

steps.en: Living cells rule out sclerenchyma, which is usually dead.
Walls thickened only at the corners are the mark of collenchyma.
Collenchyma gives mechanical support to growing parts like the petiole, and can photosynthesise when it has chloroplasts.

answer.en: Collenchyma; mechanical support to the growing petiole

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A tissue in the petiole of a leaf has living cells with walls thickened only at the corners, and some cells contain chloroplasts. Identify it and state its function.

body.en: Parenchyma: thin all round. Collenchyma: Corners thick. Sclerenchyma: thick all round with lignin (Stone-like).

narration.en: Three Cs of thickness. Parenchyma: thin all round. Collenchyma: Corners thick. Sclerenchyma: thick all round with lignin (Stone-like).
